digest_definition: per block: sha256 over per-component sha256 of {Param values; Var (value, raw lb, raw ub, fixed); Constraint (active, lower, upper, str(body)); Objective (active, str(expr)); Expression str(expr); block active flags}, as handed to optimize() at ADMM initialization (nothing solved; TSO blocks carry the initial consensus values, the same in both phases). ESSO blocks also keep the per-index state and the sha256 of the NL file Pyomo writes for them (symbolic_solver_labels False; written, never solved)
